children: China pharmaceutical maker's half-year revenue fell 18% yr/yr
Net income attributable to owners dropped 82% yr/yr
Company did not declare interim dividend for the period
Company did not provide specific guidance or outlook for the current or future periods
GROSS PROFIT DECLINE - Co's gross profit fell sharply, reflecting lower revenue and higher cost of sales
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 6 "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the pharmaceuticals peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for United Laboratories International Holdings Ltd is HK$14.75, about 72.8% above its August 28 closing price of HK$8.54
The stock recently traded at 9 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 8 three months ago
